reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Illinois
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: Are court records for eviction cases automatically made inaccessible after a certain time period?
*/

/* ---------------------------
   Basic date utilities
   --------------------------- */

date_to_int(Year, Month, Day, Int) :-
    Int is Year*10000 + Month*100 + Day.

on_or_after(DateInt, ThresholdInt) :-
    DateInt >= ThresholdInt.

/* ---------------------------
   Scenario facts (question statement)
   --------------------------- */

scenario_state(illinois).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% We model the question as asking whether there is an automatic (time-elapse-based) rule
% that makes eviction court records inaccessible.
scenario_question(automatic_time_based_inaccessibility_of_eviction_court_records).

% Choose a representative date within the focus year for applicability analysis.
scenario_date_int(DateInt) :-
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    date_to_int(Year, 1, 1, DateInt).

/* Helper predicate that succeeds when the encoded scenario statement is satisfied. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(illinois),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_question(automatic_time_based_inaccessibility_of_eviction_court_records).

/* ---------------------------
   Statute translation: 735 ILCS 5/9-121 (Sealing of court file)
   --------------------------- */

% 735 ILCS 5/9-121(d): operative on and after August 1, 2022.
statute_735_ilcs_5_9_121_operative(DateInt) :-
    date_to_int(2022, 8, 1, Threshold),
    on_or_after(DateInt, Threshold).

% 735 ILCS 5/9-121(b): discretionary sealing (court MAY order sealing if findings are made).
% We encode the conditions abstractly as predicates that would need facts to be true.
statute_735_ilcs_5_9_121_discretionary_sealing_available(Action) :-
    eviction_action(Action),
    sufficiently_without_basis_in_fact_or_law(Action),
    sealing_clearly_in_interests_of_justice(Action),
    interests_not_outweighed_by_public_interest(Action).

% 735 ILCS 5/9-121(c): mandatory sealing for certain eviction actions.
statute_735_ilcs_5_9_121_mandatory_sealing_required(Action) :-
    eviction_action(Action),
    ( eviction_action_brought_under_9_207_5(Action)
    ; eviction_action_as_set_forth_in_15_1701_h_6(Action)
    ).

% Derived: sealing is available/required only if the statute is operative.
statute_735_ilcs_5_9_121_sealing_rule_applies(DateInt, Action, discretionary) :-
    statute_735_ilcs_5_9_121_operative(DateInt),
    statute_735_ilcs_5_9_121_discretionary_sealing_available(Action).

statute_735_ilcs_5_9_121_sealing_rule_applies(DateInt, Action, mandatory) :-
    statute_735_ilcs_5_9_121_operative(DateInt),
    statute_735_ilcs_5_9_121_mandatory_sealing_required(Action).

/* ---------------------------
   Domain placeholders (no scenario facts provided for these)
   --------------------------- */

% In this question, no particular eviction case facts are given; these are placeholders so
% the statute translation is complete and callable without undefined predicates.
eviction_action(_Action) :- fail.
sufficiently_without_basis_in_fact_or_law(_Action) :- fail.
sealing_clearly_in_interests_of_justice(_Action) :- fail.
interests_not_outweighed_by_public_interest(_Action) :- fail.
eviction_action_brought_under_9_207_5(_Action) :- fail.
eviction_action_as_set_forth_in_15_1701_h_6(_Action) :- fail.

/* ---------------------------
   Reasoning about the question asked
   --------------------------- */

% The question asks about AUTOMATIC inaccessibility after a TIME PERIOD.
% 735 ILCS 5/9-121 provides sealing only via:
%   - court order with specific findings (discretionary), or
%   - mandatory sealing for specific categories.
% It does NOT create a time-elapse-based rule that automatically makes records inaccessible.
%
% Therefore, under the provided statutes, there is no automatic time-based inaccessibility.
legal_automatic_time_based_inaccessibility_of_eviction_records(_State, _DateInt) :-
    % No such rule appears in 735 ILCS 5/9-121.
    fail.

% Additionally, for focus_year 2021, even 735 ILCS 5/9-121 is not yet operative (operative 8/1/2022).
legal_any_sealing_rule_operative_in_year(DateInt) :-
    statute_735_ilcs_5_9_121_operative(DateInt).

/* ---------------------------
   Final answer predicate
   --------------------------- */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_date_int(DateInt),
    legal_automatic_time_based_inaccessibility_of_eviction_records(State, DateInt),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    % Even ignoring operability, the statute is not time-based automatic sealing;
    % and in 2021 the statute is not operative anyway.
    !.

/* ---------------------------
   Main entrypoint
   --------------------------- */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Are court records for eviction cases automatically made inaccessible for cases after certain time period?
